text: What a wonderful throw! It's nice to be able to buy .... What a wonderful throw! It's nice to be able to buy a throw blanket made from 100% cotton, vs. "microfiber" or a blanket made from synthetic materials. It's light, breathable, warm, and covers me perfectly for those naps on the sofa. Also, is a great spot of color for my otherwise neutral toned living room. Thank you!

product_metadata.title: SLPR 100% Cotton Indoor/Outdoor Geometric Machine Washable Throw (50" x 60", Blue) | for Beaches Patio BBQ Picnic Everyday Use
features: VIBRANT DESIGN & EXCEPTIONAL QUALITY – With a gorgeous Maze/ Greek Key pattern, this stunning throw comes in vibrant colors and is designed to last. Superior quality ensures consistent warmth and long-lasting style even with everyday use.
100% COTTON COMFORT – This throw doesn’t have synthetic materials, just comfortable, breathable cotton you can snuggle up to.

SUITABLE FOR ALL SEASONS - Perfect lightweight spring/summer throw can replace a duvet cover in warmer months. It’s also ideal for cooler weather. If there’s a chill in the air, wrap it around your shoulders or snuggle up with it by the fireside.

PERFECT FOR HOME OR ON THE GO – Use this lovely throw indoors or out. Ideal for the patio, porch, beach, BBQ, or picnic. Can also be used at home to decorate a favorite chair or adorn the guestroom bed.
MACHINE WASHABLE FOR EASY CARE – Toss it in the washing machine with no worries. It’s designed to retain its beauty wash after wash.
description: Light, cozy and charming—that’s the best way to describe this sensational cotton throw in beautiful shades of Orange, Green, Blue and Grey. This delightful throw has a lovely maze pattern and fringed edges. What an incredibly inviting accessory to cuddle up with. It can dress up a bedroom or add a welcoming touch to a cottage sofa. Ideal for camping, a family picnic, barbecues or everyday use. You can use it indoors or out—and it’s easy to wash, so you’ll definitely want to take it with you wherever you go! Available in the perfect size of 50” x 60”, this comfy throw is 100% cotton and is machine washable. Wash separately in cold water on a gentle setting and tumble-dry low.
